notes: All hands start a run at level 1; levels persist for the run only.
Level up sources: matching Planet card (+1), Black Hole (+1 to every hand incl. secret ones), Orbital Tag (+3 to one random visible hand), Space Joker / Burnt Joker (jokers file).
The Arm boss lowers the played hand by 1 level before scoring, never below level 1 (min level 1 since update 1.0.0k).
Royal Flush has no separate level; it uses Straight Flush's level and planet (Neptune).
Hand detection: the highest-priority hand type (priority 1 = checked first) that the played cards satisfy is used, regardless of level.
Secret hands (Five of a Kind, Flush House, Flush Five) are hidden until played once in the run; their planets cannot spawn until the hand has been played in the run.

hands.name: Flush Five
hands.definition: 5 cards of the same rank that are also all one suit (any hand that is both Five of a Kind and a Flush). Scores all 5.

hands.name: Flush House
hands.definition: A Full House whose cards are all one suit (any hand that is both a Full House and a Flush). Scores all 5.

hands.name: Five of a Kind
hands.definition: 5 cards of the same rank, not all the same suit. Scores all 5.

hands.name: Straight Flush
hands.definition: Any hand that is both a Straight and a Flush. A Royal Flush (10-J-Q-K-A suited) is displayed separately but is the same hand type for levels, planets, The Eye/The Mouth/The Ox and joker counters.

hands.name: Four of a Kind
hands.definition: 4 cards of one rank. Only those 4 cards score.

hands.name: Full House
hands.definition: 3 of one rank plus 2 of a different rank. Scores all 5.

hands.name: Flush
hands.definition: 5 cards of one suit (4 with Four Fingers). Only the flush cards score.

hands.name: Straight
hands.definition: 5 cards of consecutive rank (4 with Four Fingers; Shortcut allows one-rank gaps). Ace may be high (10-J-Q-K-A) or low (A-2-3-4-5) but a straight cannot wrap (K-A-2-3-4 is invalid). Only the straight cards score.

hands.name: Three of a Kind
hands.definition: 3 cards of one rank. Only those 3 score.

hands.name: Two Pair
hands.definition: 2 cards of one rank and 2 of another (different) rank. Those 4 score. Four/Five of a Kind do not count as containing Two Pair.

hands.name: Pair
hands.definition: 2 cards of one rank. Those 2 score.

hands.name: High Card
hands.definition: No other hand applies; only the single highest-ranked played card scores.
